WITH invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) as inv_count 
  FROM Orders o 
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id 
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
total_invoices AS (
  SELECT SUM(inv_count) as total_inv FROM invoice_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ic.inv_count,
    CAST(ic.inv_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST((SELECT total_inv FROM total_invoices) AS DECIMAL) as share
  FROM invoice_counts ic
),
avg_share_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT inv_count, share FROM shares
  CROSS JOIN avg_share_val
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(inv_count) as total_invoices,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_val)) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg
